title: Supermarket Test
summary: A virtual supermarket that assesses orientation, attention, memory and multitasking in an everyday setting.
description:
This test assesses orientation, attention, memory and multitasking in an everyday setting.

1. **Recipe** — the patient picks a recipe and collects its ingredients from a moving conveyor.
2. **Shopping** — they shop for two lists on a budget in a virtual supermarket, dealing with out-of-stock items, last-minute requests and pop-up ads.

It is part of the [Digital Cognitive Test Battery](/projects/digital-cognitive-tests).
